fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $49,950 (non-refundable). Conversion fee for pre-existing qualifying automotive styling centers is $24,950. Multi-Unit Development Fee is structured as: $89,900 for 2 centers, $119,850 for 3 centers, or $39,950 per center for 4+ centers (no separate initial franchise fee due at signing of Multi-Unit Development Agreement; a separate Franchise Agreement is required per center). A non-refundable Mobile Services Territory Fee of $10,000 is due if Mobile Services are authorized. VetFran Program provides a 10% discount on the initial franchise fee for qualifying U.S. military veterans. Existing franchisees in good standing may receive periodic special discounts on additional franchises.
raw_excerpt: When you enter into a Franchise Agreement you will pay to us a non- refundable initial franchise fee (the "Initial Franchise Fee") of $49,950. If the franchised business is a pre- existing automotive styling center that (i) has been independently owned and operated by you, (ii) meets our standards and criteria, and (iii) is approved by us for conversion to a TINT WORLD® Center, the Initial Franchise Fee is $24,950.
